candidate_relations.reason: Nasal NK/T-cell lymphoma is an EBV-positive nasal differential but the phenotype is CD138-positive, CD20-negative plasmablastic rather than NK/T.
Aggressive B-cell lymphoma is the parent family of PBL but omits plasmablastic type, stage 1, and high-risk features.
Lymphoma is a generic parent missing PBL and staging.
DLBCL is a related aggressive B-cell lymphoma but is a distinct entity from plasmablastic lymphoma (CD20-negative, CD138-positive).

case_quality_flags: CD138+/CD20-/EBV+ nasal mass with MYC/IGH gains and negative staging is PBL stage I; no candidate names plasmablastic lymphoma.
